lifecycle.official_exit_rule: mark all open positions at the final OOS close; no forced liquidation, copied from final V11 ledger

rule.selection: monthly first-session close; cached V11 LightGBM LambdaRank daily_rank=1
rule.risk: 20 prior adjusted close-to-close returns ending T-1; annualized sample volatility; exposure=min(1,0.12/vol)

volatility_audit.volatility_formula: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the selected Top1's 20 adjusted close-to-close returns from T-20 through T-1, multiplied by sqrt(252); no return on T is used

simulator: isolated copy of final V11 analysis.py; T+1 open, shared cash, corporate-action adjusted shares, ordinary 100-share lots; on zero-weight exits odd/fractional remainder sold only if participation cap can clear it, otherwise permitted lots sold and remainder retained
